berlin-motorcycle-escapes-lusatia-lakes-.story: A proper escape from Berlin motorcycle escapes with roads worth waking up for. Out of Spreenhagen and back again: 518 km, roughly 10 h 48 in the saddle. On the way it passes near Letschin, near Chorin, Scenic stretch near Gransee and Breddin. It crosses from Germany into Poland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.

berlin-motorcycle-escapes-lusatia-lakes-.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Food stop near Letschin → High point near Chorin is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

This High point near Chorin → Scenic stretch near Gransee stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.to: Near Breddin, on the way back
sections.advice: Scenic stretch near Gransee → Near Breddin, on the way back is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

sections.from: Near Breddin, on the way back

sections.advice: Photo stop near Golzow → Near Buch can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.

scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

places-puez-odle-puez-geisler-poz-odles-.story: 208 km from Selva to Selva, about 3 h 35 of riding. It goes by way of Marmolada, Sciliar-Catinaccio, Pale di San Martino San Lucano - Dolomiti and back through Sciliar-Catinaccio. The highest point is about 1,950 m. The line favours views over speed.

x-kz-tamgaly-petroglyphs-road.slogan: Tamgaly Petroglyphs Road – 124 km from Almaty to Tamgaly
x-kz-tamgaly-petroglyphs-road.story: A road-accessible heritage corridor linking major cultural landmarks. It links naturally to Petroglyphs within the Archaeological Landscape of Tamgaly.
